title: How I Reversed Fibroids Naturally: A Healing Story from Hippocrates

content:
Listen on Podbean

On this episode Anna Maria and Brian Clement welcome guest Nishiki Chandler, who shares her personal recovery from severe fibroids, heavy menstrual bleeding, and anemia.

She explains how an immersive stay at the Hippocrates Health Institute—combined with dietary changes, emotional and spiritual release, and lifestyle commitment—reduced her bleeding, eliminated anemia, improved mood and mobility, and led to confirmed disappearance of fibroids.

The conversation highlights the importance of supportive environments, routine, and inner work in reversing chronic conditions and offers hope and practical guidance for listeners seeking alternatives to surgery.
